source_note: Compiled from AFAD reports, Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality flood records, and peer-reviewed publications. Flood zone delineations based on published TUBITAK and IMM studies.

historical_floods.name: 2009 Istanbul Floods
historical_floods.description: Severe flooding in Ikitelli, Halkali, and Ayamama Creek basin. 32 deaths, widespread infrastructure damage.
historical_floods.cause: Extreme rainfall (>100mm in 3 hours) overwhelming Ayamama Creek drainage capacity

historical_floods.name: 2017 Istanbul Flash Floods
historical_floods.description: Flash flooding across European side. Metro stations flooded, traffic paralyzed for 12+ hours.
historical_floods.cause: Intense convective rainfall exceeding stormwater capacity

historical_floods.name: 2019 Summer Floods
historical_floods.description: Flooding in Esenyurt and multiple districts. Significant property damage.

historical_floods.name: 2020 September Floods
historical_floods.description: Heavy rainfall caused flooding in Kadikoy, Uskudar, and Asian side districts.
historical_floods.cause: Mediterranean low-pressure system with extreme precipitation

historical_floods.name: 2021 July Floods
historical_floods.description: Flash flooding in northern Istanbul districts. Dereler overflowed.
historical_floods.cause: Orographic rainfall enhancement near Black Sea coast
